results.name: A loaded image crossfades for 380 ms and its decorative overlay clears on completion
Rapid selection ignores old image decodes and starts only the latest transition
Selecting another item cancels an active transition; stale completion cannot hide the new one
Reduced motion cancels an active crossfade and immediately restores a single image
Reduced motion while decode is pending prevents a delayed crossfade
A decode rejection does not leave the previous image stuck over the selected scene

limits: Mocks simulate loaded images, asynchronous decode and Web Animations API completion/cancellation; browser rendering is not tested.
